title: The Rainbow Token Send

captures.note: dry: stopped at the confirm screen

_comment: Rainbow sending an ERC-20 (0.5 mUSD). Compared with its ETH send (RB1) the only new request is the token's logo, fetched from Rainbow's image CDN with the token contract address in the URL. No token screening call: unlike MetaMask (Blockaid token scan, MT) and Rabby (token identity, RT), Rainbow sent no request that vouches for the token. Same RPC path as RB1 (rpc.rainbow.me). Real mainnet tx 0xb6634fca43338b8fb94d03bc6e0fd3a102047a2064ccd754bfad796fd14c9bf6.
